title: Empirical Response Exponents and Geometric-Medium Information in Galaxy Rotation Curves

creators.name: Messaoudene, Mohammed
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Sciences, Belhadj Bouchaib University of Ain Temouchent

description: Source package for an arXiv-style preprint on channel-aware response exponents and fixed Geometric-Medium Response diagnostics in galaxy rotation curves. The package keeps direct component evidence, proxy evidence, and vector-recovered LITTLE THINGS evidence explicitly separated.
